message.content:
This portrait-oriented editorial illustration features two large, profile-view human heads, rendered in shades of red and pink. On the left, a figure with short hair and a thick neck faces right with an open-mouthed, laughing expression. On the right, a second figure with a high forehead and visible hair faces left, looking downward with a closed-mouth smile. Below their heads, two large hands meet in the center. The thumbs of these hands are transformed into small human figures from the waist up, each wearing a dark peaked cap with a light-colored emblem. These thumb-figures face each other. The hands below are clasped together.

The background is a solid pale yellow. Red text at the top reads "GERILYA MEMANGKAS KEWENANGAN KPK" and "MATI SURI KAWASAN EKONOMI KHUSUS". Central text in large red capital letters says "PILKADA SERASA PILPRES", followed by smaller black text: "PEMILIHAN GUBERNUR DI EMPAT PROVINSI MENJADI PERTARUHAN KANDIDAT PEMILU PRESIDEN. JAWA MASIH JADI ANDALAN." At the bottom left, a white box contains a barcode and text: "00018 25 JUNI-1 JULI 2018 RP 45.000 WWW.TEMPO.CO MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN ISSN 0126-4273". A large, dark, partially obscured letter sits behind the figures' heads.
